newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers softer, enquiries thin.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers softer, enquiries thin.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were a little softer from previous levels on Friday amid weakness in the crude market as well as few enquiries ahead of the weekend, traders said.
Bunker 380-cst supplies were offered $1-$2 per tonne lower at about $102/$103 and the 180-cst grade was at around $105.
"The market is pretty quiet today. Not many people are keen to trade," said one trader.
MDO and gas oil were at around $175 and $183 per tonne respectively.
